titles.title: FORMULA Act of 2026
FORMULA Act of 2026
Formula Oversight, Regulation, and Manufacturing Uniformity for Life-sustaining Assurance Act of 2026

To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to direct the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish maximum permissible levels for contaminants in infant formulas, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
